name: Bazaar (Liquid)
author: juwri
description: Clean, white-card storefront for goods and services stores — built for the multi-vertical platform. Every noun is read from the {{ vocab }} global, so the same package sells "Products" for a shop, "Services" for a business or "Rooms" for a stay. Search, category chips, one-tap add-to-cart, cart + checkout via the commerce runtime, a product deep-link view, dark mode and RTL/Arabic are all included. Zero custom JS.
